caption: the fairy-tale marble variant - enchanted chains through a storybook garden.
about: Charma runs the marble law through a fairy-tale paint job: glowing chains loop through storybook garden paths while the shooter collects charms between gap shots. Underneath the paint it is the strict classic - match three, break the chain, never let the line reach the end.
The pc build is off the current stores, carried by archive routes.
